# Psalm 129 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 129:2 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** Much they-have-afflicted-me from-my-youth; also not they-have-prevailed against-me.
- **LOGOS:** "Greatly have they afflicted me from my youth, yet they have not prevailed against me."
- **PNEUMA:** 'They've beaten me down since I was young, but they have never defeated me.'

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

- **EMET:** YHWH righteous; he-has-cut the-cords-of the-wicked.
- **LOGOS:** The LORD is righteous; he has cut the cords of the wicked.
- **PNEUMA:** But the LORD is just — he has cut the ropes the wicked tied around us.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 129:8 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** And-not said the-passers-by, 'The-blessing-of YHWH to-you; we-bless-you in-name-of YHWH.'
- **LOGOS:** nor do those who pass by say, "The blessing of the LORD be upon you! We bless you in the name of the LORD!"

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.
